nomenclature.etymology_html:
- Leucaena : From the Greek leukos "white", in reference to the colour of the flowers.
- Leucocephala : White-headed, from the Greek leukos "white" and cephalus "head".

stem_bark.text: The bark of Leucaena leucocephala is grey and brownish-coloured and rough (warty).
stem_bark.text_html: The bark of Leucaena leucocephala is grey and brownish-coloured and rough (warty).

seed.text: The seeds of Leucaena leucocephala are ovate, 8 mm long and 5 mm wide. They are glossy and brown-coloured. There are about 30 seeds per pod.
seed.text_html: The seeds of Leucaena leucocephala are ovate, 8 mm long and 5 mm wide. They are glossy and brown-coloured. There are about 30 seeds per pod.

fruit.text: The fruit of Leucaena leucocephala is a flat and oblong pod with a 1.5-2 cm long peduncle. The fruit is 15-25 cm long and 2-2.5 cm wide, brown-coloured when ripe. Each pod contains about 30 seeds.
fruit.text_html: The fruit of Leucaena leucocephala is a flat and oblong pod with a 1.5-2 cm long peduncle. The fruit is 15-25 cm long and 2-2.5 cm wide, brown-coloured when ripe. Each pod contains about 30 seeds.

flower.text: The flowers of Leucaena leucocephala are grouped in compact globose heads with 2-2.5 cm long peduncles . The calyx-tube is campanulate, 5-lobed, 2.5 mm long and 1 mm across. The calyx is white and light green-coloured. The corolla is composed of 5 cream-coloured and glabrous petals. The petals are linear-oblong, 4 mm long and 0.5 mm wide. The androecium is composed of 10 stamens. The filaments are 5 mm long. The style is 6 mm long with a simple stigma at the tip. The flowers are fragrant.
flower.text_html:
The flowers of Leucaena leucocephala are grouped in compact globose heads with 2-2.5 cm long peduncles.
The calyx-tube is campanulate, 5-lobed, 2.5 mm long and 1 mm across. The calyx is white and light green-coloured.
The corolla is composed of 5 cream-coloured and glabrous petals. The petals are linear-oblong, 4 mm long and 0.5 mm wide.
The androecium is composed of 10 stamens. The filaments are 5 mm long.
The style is 6 mm long with a simple stigma at the tip.
The flowers are fragrant.

leaf.text: The leaves of Leucaena leucocephala grow alternately on the stem (spirally arranged). The leaf is compound, biparipinnate with numerous pairs of small leaflets. The leaflets are dark green-coloured above and paler beneath. The leaflet is chartaceous and glabrous on both sides. The leaflets are subsessile. The leaflet of Leucaena leucocephala is 1.5 cm long and 0.5 cm wide. The shape of the blade is oblong, the apex is obtuse or shorty acuminate, the base is obliquely rounded and the margins are entire. The venation of the leaflets is pinnate.

habit.text: Leucaena leucocephala is a thornless, small-sized and deciduous tree growing up to 10-12 m high.
habit.text_html: Leucaena leucocephala is a thornless, small-sized and deciduous tree growing up to 10-12 m high.

reproduction_dispersal.text: Leucaena leucocephala is bisexual (each flower of each individual has both male and female structures). Leucaena leucocephala is pollinated by a wide variety of insects. Mechanical dispersal : barochory (dispersal of seeds by gravity), self-propagation. The seeds disperse from the fruits and germinate on sites with favourable conditions : the ripe dry fruits open to release the seeds.
reproduction_dispersal.text_html:
• Sex distribution :

    Leucaena leucocephala is bisexual (each flower of each individual has both male and female structures).

  • Mode of pollination :

    Leucaena leucocephala is pollinated by a wide variety of insects.

  • Seed dispersal :

    Mechanical dispersal : barochory (dispersal of seeds by gravity), self-propagation.
    The seeds disperse from the fruits and germinate on sites with favourable conditions : the ripe dry fruits open to release the seeds.

veterinary.text: The pod of Leucaena leucocephala provides an excellent source of high-protein cattle fodder .

culinary.text: The young pods of Leucaena leucocephala are edible and occasionally eaten as a vegetable.

reforestation.text: Leucaena leucocephala is a light demander and fairly drought resistant. It is drought resistant and it will grow in a wide variety of situations and soils but all soils need to be free draining. The species is propagated by seeds or by cuttings. 24 hours of soaking in water accelerates the germination process.
reforestation.text_html:
• Planting advice and requirements :

    Leucaena leucocephala is a light demander and fairly drought resistant. It is drought resistant and it will grow in a wide variety of situations and soils but all soils need to be free draining.
    The species is propagated by seeds or by cuttings.

  • Seed treatments :

    24 hours of soaking in water accelerates the germination process.
